_note: Everything a member changes lives here. Times are SOURCE seconds in segments (the numbers below are example values: Claude sets them per take at real pauses); every other moment is a spoken phrase (matched in assets/words-cut.json), so the look re-times itself to a new take. Run cut.py, then build.py. Rule of the look: never two extras (card, sticker, big zoom) on screen at once; build.py refuses overlaps.
_segments_note: One object per take. src = your SDR take; keep = [start, end] spans in source seconds; shift_px slides the take down (0 here); grade is optional.
_word_fixes_note: Words whisper mishears in YOUR take, e.g. {"Kanva": "Canva"}. Phrase keys work across words.
_hook_note: 2 lines, 5-9 words, one emoji at most (never a rocket). until = the first word you say AFTER your spoken hook.
_list_cards_note: Optional. A numbered label when you say a numbered point out loud: number + the label you say. from / until = spoken phrases. side = left or right.
_stickers_note: Optional, and only with YOUR own art: sprite = a folder in assets/sprites/ holding f0.png, f1.png ... (frames = how many). partner = an optional second sprite beside it. sound = typing, pop or thud (or leave it out). corner = left or right. No art in assets/sprites/ = the sticker is skipped (use Edits' GIF library instead).
_zooms_note: Hard punch-ins on your big lines: at / to = spoken phrases, scale 1.12 (small) or 1.25 (big). sound is optional (thud).
_keywords_note: Words that may turn the accent colour in a caption (the first one in each caption group wins).
